# B.L.A.S.T. OCR Engine

> B.L.A.S.T. OCR is an enterprise-grade, high-throughput OCR and document intelligence engine with ONNX Runtime multi-provider acceleration (CUDA, DirectML, CPU), bounded streaming memory (< 0.000 MB/page leak slope), 99.2% TEDS table extraction, mathematical formula parsing, selectable dual-layer sandwich PDFs, and native AI Agent (MCP, LangChain, LlamaIndex) integrations.

B.L.A.S.T. is engineered for high-throughput batch processing and agentic RAG ingestion. It delivers 29.1 pages/sec on GPU and 4.2 pages/sec on CPU using batched PP-OCRv4 models with SIMD pre-processing and dynamic aspect-ratio bucketing. It natively processes PDFs, PPTX presentations, and scanned images into Markdown, DOCX, EPUB 3.0, dual-layer searchable PDF, and structured JSON.

## Key Features & Benchmark Highlights
- 29.1 pages/sec throughput on GPU (PP-OCRv4 ONNX Runtime).
- 99.2% Table Extraction accuracy (TEDS score) to GitHub Flavored Markdown and HTML.
- LaTeX formula detection converting inline and display math to KaTeX.
- Bounded memory sliding-window streaming with zero VRAM/RAM accumulation on 1,000+ page runs.
- Selectable dual-layer sandwich PDF generation with exact coordinate alignment.
- Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Antigravity.
- LangChain (`BlastOCRDocumentLoader`) and LlamaIndex (`BlastOCRReader`) connectors.
- 100% private and offline execution with zero external cloud dependencies.

- [2026 Benchmark Report](https://blast-ocr.dev/docs/BENCHMARKS_2026.md): Quantitative evaluations against Tesseract, EasyOCR, Docling, Marker, Surya, and AWS Textract.
- [API Reference](https://blast-ocr.dev/docs/API_REFERENCE.md): Full Python SDK, CLI arguments, and FastAPI REST endpoint schemas.
- [Performance Tuning](https://blast-ocr.dev/docs/PERFORMANCE_TUNING.md): ONNX batch sizing, SIMD pre-processing, and sliding-window memory tuning.
- [Security Hardening](https://blast-ocr.dev/docs/SECURITY_HARDENING.md): Sandboxed file access, path traversal prevention, and 8-class forensic PII redaction.
- [Deployment Guide](https://blast-ocr.dev/docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md): Docker Compose, Kubernetes, and production multi-worker swarm setup.
- [Troubleshooting & Recovery](https://blast-ocr.dev/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Common failure modes, self-healing recipes, and recovery mechanisms.
